free_text: The decision to recommend biopsy is clear because the retrieved evidence strongly aligns with both the guideline criterion and the statistical prior. The PI-RADS 4 finding on the mpMRI, coupled with the rising PSA trend from 5.3 ng/mL to 12.0 ng/mL, mandates re-biopsy according to protocol. This finding overturned any potential hesitation based on the prior negative biopsy status.
